importSemantics.generatedDataPolicy: derivedWeaknesses are review metadata only and must not overwrite authoredRequirements.
importSemantics.routePolicy: AP world must resolve active YAML mode, active faction, and active general, then apply unit/facility item requirements with CollectionState.
importSemantics.productionPolicy: A unit counts only when its unit item/group and every production facility item in allRequiredItemIds are owned.
importSemantics.economyBuffPolicy: Mission conditions such as economy_floor and production_floor are separate from cluster weaknesses.
importSemantics.yellowPolicy: Yellow/helper routes are tracker-only and must not grant AP logical access.

routeModes.label: Faction Shared
routeModes.description: AP items unlock faction-level groups. Validation checks each active general route separately so faction-shared items do not imply cross-general fielding.
routeModes.designNotes: Static authoring validation can prove that each faction/general route has at least one legal producer for each covered weakness while still treating item names as faction-shared.

routeModes.label: General Specific
routeModes.description: AP items may be scoped to a specific general. Validation checks concrete faction/general routes.
routeModes.designNotes: The AP world must still evaluate actual owned item state; Foundry only checks the authored route metadata is internally possible.

routeModes.label: Abstract Shared
routeModes.description: AP items may represent abstract shared answers such as Shared_RocketInfantry.
routeModes.designNotes: Foundry exports the mode for AP-world import, but does not pre-simulate abstract shared item resolution.

clusterWeaknessTags.label: Anti-Air
clusterWeaknessTags.description: Player units that can reliably remove aircraft used as cluster defenders.
examples: RPG troopers when the route can field them
clusterWeaknessTags.designNotes: Cluster-facing only when aircraft are deliberately allowed into spawn pools.

clusterWeaknessTags.label: Anti-Rifle Infantry
clusterWeaknessTags.description: Player units that cleanly answer rifle, mob, and basic infantry cluster units.
clusterWeaknessTags.designNotes: Use for infantry bodies whose threat is volume, rifles, or basic swarm pressure.

clusterWeaknessTags.label: Anti-Rocket Infantry
clusterWeaknessTags.description: Player units that can handle missile infantry without relying on fragile armor attrition.
clusterWeaknessTags.designNotes: Separate from rifle infantry because RPG/Missile Defender packs punish different player routes.

clusterWeaknessTags.label: Anti-Tank
clusterWeaknessTags.description: Player units that answer main battle tanks and durable ground armor.
clusterWeaknessTags.designNotes: This is unit-answer capability, not a numeric damage bucket.

clusterWeaknessTags.label: Anti-Light Vehicle
clusterWeaknessTags.description: Player units that counter technicals, humvees, gattling vehicles, and other fast light armor.
clusterWeaknessTags.designNotes: Keeps light vehicle pressure distinct from heavy tank requirements.

clusterWeaknessTags.label: Anti-Elite
clusterWeaknessTags.description: Player answers for elite or boss-like combat units that require either a dedicated elite answer or an explicit combo.
clusterWeaknessTags.designNotes: This is the cluster-facing version of frontline pressure. It can be covered directly or by the explicit anti-tank plus anti-light-vehicle combo rule.

comboRule.notes: A route may answer elite units with a direct anti-elite group or by having both anti-tank and anti-light-vehicle coverage.

missionConditionTags.label: Siege
missionConditionTags.description: Mission Hold/Win condition for static defenses, bases, or entrenched objectives.
missionConditionTags.designNotes: Not a cluster unit weakness in this model.

missionConditionTags.label: Area Control
missionConditionTags.description: Mission Hold/Win condition for reinforcement lanes, chokepoints, or sustained swarm pressure.
missionConditionTags.designNotes: Kept out of cluster weaknesses to avoid making every swarm a vague AoE check.

missionConditionTags.label: Economy Floor
missionConditionTags.description: Mission-level starting money or cash-flow expectation.
missionConditionTags.designNotes: Never substitutes for a missing cluster weakness.

missionConditionTags.label: Production Floor
missionConditionTags.description: Mission-level build or rebuild throughput expectation.
missionConditionTags.designNotes: Mission condition only; not a unit answer.
